metadata.title: Tesla’s Mysterious Profit Beat Is Solved. A Tariff Refund Boosted Margins. <!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Tesla’s Mysterious Margin Beat Is Finally Solved
Tesla reported fine third-quarter numbers on Wednesday, which was a relief, given what happened after the company’s second-quarter report. Importantly, automotive gross profit margin beat Wall Street estimates, but that was helped by a one-time item.
